staff_email_lower_uq.name: staff_email_lower_uq
staff_email_lower_uq.where: "core"."staff"."deleted_at" is null and "core"."staff"."email" is not null

staff_google_sub_uq.name: staff_google_sub_uq
staff_google_sub_uq.where: "core"."staff"."google_sub" is not null and "core"."staff"."deleted_at" is null

workspace_group_mappings_kind_check.name: workspace_group_mappings_kind_check
workspace_group_mappings_kind_check.value: ("core"."workspace_group_mappings"."kind"::text = 'role' and "core"."workspace_group_mappings"."role" is not null and "core"."workspace_group_mappings"."position_id" is null) or ("core"."workspace_group_mappings"."kind"::text = 'position' and "core"."workspace_group_mappings"."position_id" is not null and "core"."workspace_group_mappings"."role" is null)

history_events_shape_check.name: history_events_shape_check
history_events_shape_check.value: ("core"."history_events"."kind" = 'comentario' and "core"."history_events"."comment" is not null and "core"."history_events"."field" is null) or ("core"."history_events"."kind" = 'cambio' and "core"."history_events"."field" is not null and "core"."history_events"."comment" is null)

projects_code_uq.name: projects_code_uq
projects_code_uq.where: "core"."projects"."deleted_at" is null and "core"."projects"."code" is not null

projects_dates_check.name: projects_dates_check
projects_dates_check.value: "core"."projects"."start_date" is null or "core"."projects"."end_date" is null or "core"."projects"."end_date" >= "core"."projects"."start_date"

tasks_project_system_key_uq.name: tasks_project_system_key_uq
tasks_project_system_key_uq.where: "core"."tasks"."system_key" is not null and "core"."tasks"."deleted_at" is null

tasks_project_template_uq.name: tasks_project_template_uq
tasks_project_template_uq.where: "core"."tasks"."template_id" is not null and "core"."tasks"."deleted_at" is null

tasks_phase_needs_workflow_check.name: tasks_phase_needs_workflow_check
tasks_phase_needs_workflow_check.value: "core"."tasks"."phase_id" is null or "core"."tasks"."workflow_id" is not null

tasks_kind_check.name: tasks_kind_check
tasks_kind_check.value: ("core"."tasks"."kind"::text = 'workflow' and "core"."tasks"."template_id" is not null and "core"."tasks"."workflow_id" is not null) or ("core"."tasks"."kind"::text = 'usuario' and "core"."tasks"."template_id" is null) or ("core"."tasks"."kind"::text = 'admin' and "core"."tasks"."template_id" is null and "core"."tasks"."workflow_id" is null and "core"."tasks"."phase_id" is null and "core"."tasks"."space_id" is null)

core.client_stats.definition: select "client_id", count(*)::int as "total_projects", count(*) filter (where "status" = 'activo')::int as "active_projects", min("start_date") as "first_work_date", coalesce(sum("contract_amount_mxn"), 0) as "total_contracted_mxn" from "core"."projects" where "core"."projects"."deleted_at" is null and "core"."projects"."client_id" is not null group by "core"."projects"."client_id"
core.client_stats.name: client_stats
